system.description: The Brujah consider themselves brothers and sisters working toward common goals by different means, but this character has taken her individuality too far and become an outcast. At two points, she has insulted one of the clan's ideological extremes by word or deed, raising the difficulty of Social rolls with Brujah of the opposing viewpoint by three (reduced to one for the rare moderate). At four points, she has committed an act of treachery or murder against a clanmate, and word has spread throughout the clan: Brujah will neither aid her nor speak with her, nor accept her help except to avoid Final Death, and the clan treats her as Caitiff. Restoration to good standing, while conceivable, is rarely sought and rarely granted.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots
